proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ X N hX
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  have h : ∀ ω, X ω = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, if k + 1 ≤ X ω then 1 else 0 := by
    intro ω
    rw [Finset.sum_boole]
    have : (Finset.range N).filter (fun k => k + 1 ≤ X ω) = Finset.range (X ω) := by
      ext k
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      have := hX ω
      omega
    rw [this, Finset.card_range]
    simp
  have h2 : ∑ ω, X ω = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => k + 1 ≤ X ω)).card := by
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => h ω)]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_boole]
    simp
  rw [h2]
  push_cast
  rfl
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (X : Ω → ℕ) (N : ℕ), (∀ ω, X ω ≤ N) → ((∑ ω, X ω : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => k + 1 ≤ X ω)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω
